claim: Of the contact-with-body-part examples in [9] (She poked him in the ribs / She poked his ribs): “see Ch. 4, §7.4, for further discussion of the alternation in [9]”.
evidence_summary: Ch. 4, §7, “Light verbs”, has only §§7.1–7.2 (contents, p. 214). The alternation is treated in §8.4, “Contrasts between separate complements and a single combined complement” (p. 320): [78i] She kissed him on the cheek / She kissed his cheek, with poke and hit in the verb list [79i] (p. 321).
finding: Change §7.4 to §8.4. Ch. 4 has no §7.4. CG-0068 concerns the passive pair [9iii].

evidence.passage: §4.2, p. 681. “see Ch. 4, §7.4, for further discussion of the alternation in [9]”.
